ruleDefinitions.name: Audio Capture via PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects audio capture via PowerShell Cmdlet.

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*WindowsAudioDevice\\-Powershell\\-Cmdlet.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Toggle\\-AudioDevice.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Get\\-AudioDevice\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Set\\-AudioDevice\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Write\\-AudioDevice\\ .*"))
